spec.description: Kingspan AIR-CELL Insulation Tape is a reinforced aluminium foil tape engineered to provide a durable vapour seal join in aluminium-faced insulation products. Designed for use across the insulation and air conditioning industries, it features high-grab pressure-sensitive adhesion. The reinforced backing delivers an exceptional combination of tensile strength, flexibility and conformability.
features: Effective vapour sealing of aluminium foil faced insulations
Available in silver and white finish
Fire retardant with early fire hazard properties
Flexible and conformable to corners and irregular surfaces
Hand tearable for ease of application
applications: vapour seal joins for AIR-CELL reflective insulation in roofs, walls and floors
aluminium faced pliable building membrane joints
spec.fire: Fire retardant; early fire hazard properties compliant with AS 1530.2
spec.compliance: AS/NZS 4200.1, AS/NZS 4859.1:2018; Cetec Green Star compliant
spec.sustainability: Low VOC emitting (< 0.5 mg/m²/hr); Cetec Certified Green Star compliant
install: Ensure surfaces to be taped are clean, dry and completely free of dust, oil and contaminants
Align sheets with minimum 50mm overlap or tightly butted as specified for the application
Centre the tape squarely over the joint
Press down firmly along the entire length of the tape
Wipe down with a plastic squeegee or roller to activate pressure-sensitive adhesive and remove air pockets
Do not stretch tape during application to avoid tension wrinkles
selection_checklist: Confirm width needed (48mm for wall cavity joins, 72mm for roof/general applications, 96mm for heavy commercial)
Select color finish (silver for standard foil, white for AIR-CELL Insulwhite)
Calculate total lineal meters required including overlaps and penetrations
Verify application surface is completely clean and dry
limitations: Pressure-sensitive adhesive requires firm rubbing / rolling down for complete bonding
Substrate must be completely dry and clean prior to application
Non-structural; not suitable for carrying tensile loads
Avoid contact with wet cement, lime or strong alkaline materials
spec.warranty: Covered under Kingspan AIR-CELL product warranty system

use_cases: sealing overlaps and butt joins of Kingspan AIR-CELL insulation in metal and tiled roof systems
creating continuous vapour barrier seals across wall insulation joints in brick veneer and framed walls
sealing joints on HVAC duct wrap to prevent thermal leakage and condensation
patching accidental tears or penetrations in foil building membranes
not_for: direct immersion in water or subterranean waterproofing
unsupported expansion joints with high thermal movement
retrieval.rag_summary: Kingspan AIR-CELL Foil Tape (Insulation Tape) is a high-tensile, reinforced aluminium foil tape coated with an aggressive pressure-sensitive synthetic adhesive designed to create continuous vapour-tight seals along insulation joints. Available in 48mm, 72mm, and 96mm widths in silver or white, it conforms securely to overlaps and irregular edges on AIR-CELL reflective insulation, HVAC ductwork, and pliable building membranes. Fire-retardant and Green Star compliant with low VOC emissions, it prevents air and moisture leakage to ensure maximum installed thermal efficiency and condensation management.
